title: Add-backs marked for one supervisor’s district
question: Do some districts draw more add-back money than others?
finding: In the 2014–2017 lists district-marked lines ranged from $2.7 million (District 1) to $4.5 million (District 10); from 2018 the lists set an equal sum per district, about $0.5–1 million each a year.
how: First-year lines whose district column names exactly one district, added up by district for 2014–2017 and for 2018–2026.
limits: Citywide lines often benefit one neighbourhood without saying so, and district numbers on the scanned lists are sometimes misread. The lists print a district, not a sponsor.
